supporting: A Careers360 news report from November 2023 says a 2022 Ministry of Information and Broadcasting report estimated over 1.6 lakh new jobs in animation, visual effects, gaming and comics (AVGC) by 2025. It names roles such as game design and development, programming, mobile games, testing and art.

The same report cites an E-Gaming Federation and Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata survey of 4,644 people aged 19 to 50. In it, programming (44 percent) and testing and automation (40 percent) were the most common interests, and art was named by 16 percent.

It also quotes entry pay of about Rs 3 to 5 lakh a year and about Rs 13 to 15 lakh after four years from the head of a staffing and education firm. That is one person's estimate, not a pay study, so read live notices before relying on it.

figures.label: Education Budget Amount
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a Rs 10 lakh budget, a tenth is Rs 1 lakh for the main course. The rest can fund a capable laptop, a few months of unpaid game work and a reserve.
